data.name: Lucky Newt
data.detailed_description:
Lucky Newt: The Next Big 3D Platformer Has Arrived!

Join Lucky Newt on a twisting 3D adventure! 

Salazar has taken over your home the Luckypad Lagoon! The evil giant salamander Salazar has resurrected, and he’s after the mythical 5 Leaf Clover, the most powerful lucky charm in existence.

It’s up to this team of amphibians to stop him and save their home. Join Nedley Newt and his two best pals, Amelia Axolotl and Murphy Mudpuppy, on a colorful, heartfelt journey through the magical Luckypad Lagoon, a world teetering on the brink of disaster.

Use his incredible new powers to defy gravity with just a step of his foot, he can stick to walls like a magnet, unlocking new paths and taking down fearsome foes like never before!

A Platforming Adventure for All Ages

Play solo or bring along a friend or family member in this two-player co-op adventure filled with clever mechanics, hidden secrets, and unforgettable characters. Whether you’re a seasoned platforming fan or a newcomer, Lucky Newt is a fresh take on a beloved genre.

Determined, courageous, and a little bit clumsy, Nedley is always ready to leap into action. With a heart full of questions and a spirit full of hope, he’s out to discover his true purpose and maybe save the world along the way.

Amelia Axolotl is a charming, unique creature not seen in the Luckypad Lagoon. Though a bit shy, this fashion-forward axolotl has a heart full of love. After getting lost far from home, she’s embraced her new journey, proving that even the softest souls can shine the brightest.

Murphy Mudpuppy is a lovable goofball who never misses a chance to crack a joke or pull a harmless prank. He's got a heart of gold, always ready to cheer on his brother Nedley and stick by his friends through thick and thin.

Core Features

Wall Walking!
Run up to a wall and with a single step stick to it like a magnet! Use this move to scale new heights and reach new areas and terrible foes like never before!

Tail Spin!
Use Nedley’s Tail Spin! A quick, twirling attack to swat away enemies or gain extra distance mid-air. Mastering this move lets you chain jumps together, reach hidden platforms, and stay safe while exploring the world.

2-Player!

Whether playing locally or online, experience the adventure together with friends or family! With split-screen mode, you can team up to conquer each level in no time, and if you don’t have a second companion, no worries you can seamlessly swap between both characters in real time, creating dynamic, puzzle-solving gameplay!

Expansive Worlds!

Lucky Newt features expansive, interconnected worlds inspired by classics like classic 3D platformers. Each level is a large, open environment filled with secrets, platforming challenges, and characters to interact with encouraging exploration and rewarding curiosity.

Charms!
Discover powerful lucky items that boost your abilities and help in battles against Salazar’s minions. Each charm offers unique powers that can turn the tide in your favor.

  • Horseshoe

  • Penny

  • Lucky Rabbit’s Foot

  • Ladybug

  • Acorn

Collect them all and harness the full luck of the lagoon!

Be a Part of the Journey

Lucky Newt (Prototype) is just the beginning. Your support and feedback will help shape the future of this world and the characters that live in it.

data.short_description: Join Lucky Newt, Amelia Axolotl, and Murphy Mudpuppy on a vibrant, story-rich co-op platforming adventure to stop the evil Salazar from stealing the legendary 5 Leaf Clover and taking over their home. Play solo or with a friend in this small world full of luck!
